subject: Mobile Development
title: Phones Replace Everything
description: A quick, practical guide to Phones Replace Everything.

hook.text: Your phone has replaced your camera, alarm clock, GPS, music player, and flashlight.

buildup.text: It also replaced your calculator, compass, level, boarding pass, and car keys.

discovery.text: Entire industries — cameras, MP3 players, standalone GPS — collapsed because of smartphones.

twist.text: The average person checks their phone 150 times per day. We've become dependent.

climax.text: The smartphone is the most disruptive single product in the history of consumer technology.

punchline.text: One device killed a dozen industries.

quiz.question: How many times does the average person check their phone daily?
